embeds.title: 🟡 PoC Code Published for Critical NGINX Vulnerability CVE-2026-42945
embeds.description:
Proof-of-concept exploit code has been published for CVE-2026-42945, a critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability (CVSS 9.2) in NGINX's ngx_http_rewrite_module. F5 patched the vulnerability in NGINX Plus versions 37.0.0, R36 P4, and R32 P6, and in NGINX open source versions 1.31.0 and 1.30.1. The vulnerability could enable denial-of-service attacks or remote code execution if ASLR is disabled. According to Depthfirst, the flaw stems from a two-pass process in the script engine that can lead to undersized buffer allocation when rewrite replacements contain question marks.
